evals.prompt: Audit a directory containing portable and client-extended Agent Skills, then produce a prioritized migration report.
evals.expected_output: A report that separates official specification failures, intentional client-extension exceptions, and best-practice warnings, with file-level evidence and validation commands.
assertions: The report identifies the Agent Skills documentation and retrieval date used as the baseline
The report separates hard specification failures from recommendations
The report does not recommend removing a safety extension without an equivalent control
Every migration phase includes a concrete validation method

evals.prompt: A 700-line discipline-enforcing SKILL.md has client-only frontmatter and unreliable triggering. Refactor it without weakening its safety behavior.
evals.expected_output: A staged refactor that preserves verified safety controls, splits details into directly linked references, optimizes the standard description through train/validation trigger evals, and compares behavior with the old version.
assertions: The plan preserves client safety behavior until an equivalent replacement exists
SKILL.md is reduced below 500 lines with one-level conditional references
Description optimization uses positive, near-miss negative, train, validation, repeated runs, and fresh holdout queries
Output evaluation compares against a snapshot of the previous skill in clean contexts
The final result distinguishes portable compliance from local-client compatibility

evals.prompt: 帮我看看这个技能为什么代理总是不按它走，顺便精简一下。
evals.expected_output: 检查指针措辞、完成条件、无效指令、禁令式表达和信息层级，给出有依据的删改建议，不只按行数精简。
assertions: 检查描述或指针的触发措辞
识别模型默认就会做的无效指令
把禁令改写为正面目标或说明保留理由
区分应留在正文与应拆出的参考
